title: Migrate os.path calls to pathlib.Path
description: A Python file_utils module uses os.path throughout. Migrate it to use pathlib.Path equivalents. Tests verify the same behavior is preserved.

files.test_file_utils.py:
import os
import tempfile
import pytest
from file_utils import file_exists, ensure_dir, join_paths, get_extension, list_files


def test_file_exists_true(tmp_path):
    f = tmp_path / "hello.txt"
    f.write_text("hi")
    assert file_exists(str(f)) is True


def test_file_exists_false(tmp_path):
    assert file_exists(str(tmp_path / "nope.txt")) is False


def test_ensure_dir(tmp_path):
    new_dir = str(tmp_path / "a" / "b" / "c")
    result = ensure_dir(new_dir)
    assert result == new_dir
    assert os.path.isdir(new_dir)


def test_join_paths():
    result = join_paths("a", "b", "c.txt")
    assert result == os.path.join("a", "b", "c.txt")


def test_get_extension():
    assert get_extension("report.pdf") == ".pdf"
    assert get_extension("noext") == ""
    assert get_extension("archive.tar.gz") == ".gz"


def test_list_files(tmp_path):
    (tmp_path / "a.txt").write_text("")
    (tmp_path / "b.py").write_text("")
    (tmp_path / "c.txt").write_text("")
    all_files = list_files(str(tmp_path))
    assert all_files == ["a.txt", "b.py", "c.txt"]
    txt_files = list_files(str(tmp_path), extension=".txt")
    assert txt_files == ["a.txt", "c.txt"]


def test_list_files_missing_dir(tmp_path):
    result = list_files(str(tmp_path / "nonexistent"))
    assert result == []

task_spec.prompt:
Migrate file_utils.py from os.path to pathlib.Path.

Replace each function body:
- file_exists: use Path(path).is_file()
- ensure_dir: use Path(path).mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True), return path
- join_paths: use str(Path(*parts)) or Path(parts[0]).joinpath(*parts[1:])
- get_extension: use Path(path).suffix
- list_files: use Path(directory).is_dir(), Path(directory).iterdir(), p.is_file(), p.suffix or p.name.endswith()

Keep the function signatures identical (str in, str/list out). Do NOT import os anymore.

Run `pytest test_file_utils.py -v --rootdir=.` to verify all 8 tests pass.
